notes: The Great Hearth of Hearth Square, redrawn 2026-11-17 (lane/fix138-hearth-chest-big; Tyler: "if you can make it amazing"): readable dressed blocks like the gatehouse, a slate cupola with an iron finial (the flue's smoke leaves its openings, ambient-life.js EMITTERS), a red banner with the gold H, the carved Hearthrise crest, a lantern, four different bays (full logs, kindling, iron tools and a scuttle, bricked half up with a crack), steps, an embers-only firebox (hearth_fire's loop lies over it with its anchor on hearth px (178, 313), tools/world-art/hearth-fire.mjs) and an empty stone dais with two iron chain rings right of it, where the Hearth Chest stands (src/data/world/town/sites.js CHEST_SEAT, its foot on hearth px (290, 364)). Its wings end in dressed stone caps (2026-11-18: an eave run past the wall, a quoined corner, a corner stone on the curb) that stand on the paving as the square's other buildings do, weeds and moss in the paving by their foot (sites.js); the art lies inside x 26-358 of a 384 px canvas, shipped with 16 transparent columns cut off each side (tools/world-art/hearth-fire.mjs), so its frame is its footprint, 11 x 4 at x112-122 y45-48 as before (the art stands 10 px inside its first column and 9 px inside its last) and the walk mask does not move; its anchor is the front step's last row. The previous Hearth (2026-10-25) is kept as art/world-src/havora-hearth/great_hearth-2026-10-25.png for the Tower window's chimney course only (tools/world-art/tower-window-art.mjs).
